summary: This note covers season six of One Tree Hill. It states that this season is the final one for original cast members Chad Michael Murray and Hilarie Burton. In the season finale, their characters Lucas and Peyton leave Tree Hill with their newborn baby.
one_line: Summary of One Tree Hill season six, the final season for original cast members Chad Michael Murray and Hilarie Burton.
key_facts: Season six is the final season for original cast members Chad Michael Murray and Hilarie Burton.
Chad Michael Murray and Hilarie Burton are original cast members of One Tree Hill.
Chad Michael Murray plays the character Lucas in One Tree Hill.
Hilarie Burton plays the character Peyton in One Tree Hill.
Lucas and Peyton leave Tree Hill with their newborn baby in the finale.
The season six finale features the departure of Lucas and Peyton from Tree Hill.
